description: Client-side JavaScript code managing file upload UI, progress tracking, and iframe content handling for party profile content.

methods.name: uploadPartyContent
methods.description: Initializes file upload process, sets up iframe target, and prepares UI elements.

methods.name: uploadCompleted
methods.description: Handles completion of upload, updates content list, and resets UI elements.

methods.name: checkIframeStatus
methods.description: Polls iframe content to determine if upload is complete.

methods.name: getUploadProgressStatus
methods.description: Starts polling server for upload progress and updates progress bar accordingly.
